title: Austin Leaders Certify Vote for New Policies
summary:
*   A special meeting was held to officially confirm the results of recent elections.
*   The agenda focused specifically on validating the outcomes of both the City Council election and a Charter Amendment election.
*   The council's main task was to "canvass the returns," which is the formal process of reviewing and declaring the final results from the April 1st votes.
transcript:
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
TO THE MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN: Notice is hereby given that a
Special Meeting of the City Council of the City of Austin will be held on the 3rd day of
April, 1967, at the Municipal Building, Eighth and Colorado, in Austin, Texas, 10:00 A.M.
for the purpose of canvassing the Returns of the Austin City Council Election and of the
Charter Amendment Election held on April 1, 1967. s/ Elsie Woosley
City Clerk
s/ Lester E. Palmer
